name: Achilles
subtitle: Myrmidon's Wrath
description: Single target melee warrior who empowers their damage through Bleeds
lore: A great war leader of Olympus, Achilles burns with resentment and rage. The Shattering robbed him of his opportunity for vengeance against the Trojan Prince Hector, and the shift in magics weakened the mystical invulnerability he once enjoyed. Despite his newfound limitations, Achilles has grown more reckless in battle rather than more cautious, driven by seething emotions that make him deeply unpredictable.
divinity_generator: Gain [60] Divinity when placing a [Bleed] on an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Rage of the Myrmidon
Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%
Awaken the ability: Dance of Chiron

skills.name: Achilles Heel
skills.description: Inflicts 20% increased damage to enemies under [mechanic:bleed] but receives 20% increased damage from enemies under [mechanic:bleed].

skills.name: Rage of the Myrmidon
skills.description: Place [mechanic:atk-up-ii] and [mechanic:sharpen-ii] on this hero for 2 turns then gains an [Extra Turn].
skills.awakening_bonus: Also place [Retaliate] on this hero for 2 turns.

skills.name: Dance of Chiron
skills.description: Remove all stacks of [mechanic:bleed] on the target then Attack 3 times. Damage inflicted increases by 15% for each stack of [mechanic:bleed] removed.
skills.awakening_bonus: ATK increases by 1% up to a maximum of 50% for each stack of [Bleed] removed.

skills.name: Adroit Manoeuver
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy with a 50% chance to place 3 stacks of [mechanic:bleed].

imprint_passive: Inflicts 10% increased damage to enemies under [Bleed] but receives 20% increased damage from enemies under [Bleed].
